# US x Iran ceasefire through September 30: research brief (as of 2026-09-22)

Many page fetches failed through the proxy, including Wikipedia, CRS, ISW and Polymarket. Most facts below come from search-result summaries and should be spot-checked.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria name no URL or data series. Resolution rests on official US and Iranian government and military statements plus a consensus of credible reporting. CENTCOM press releases are the main primary source for US strikes. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/)
- Key nuance: only strikes that hit Iran's land territory or internal waters count. Strikes on tankers at sea (for example in the Gulf of Oman) probably fall outside "Iran" as the market defines it, since maritime territory is excluded.
- I could not load the Polymarket market page to see its rules or current status.

## 2. Current status
- No formal US-Iran ceasefire is in force. The June 28 agreement (MoU) collapsed after Iran attacked shipping on July 8, and the MoU expired in August. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iran_war), [CRS](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/R48887)
- The question is therefore really about whether the current lull in US strikes on Iranian soil lasts through September 30.
- The last confirmed US strikes on Iranian land were the September 1 wave on southern coastal targets. The later US actions I found (September 5 and 8) hit tankers at sea.
- I found no report of a US strike on Iranian territory between September 9 and September 22. Nothing so far settles the question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-21: ISW's update covers IRGC activity in Yemen, a September 20 interview in which Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, cast Iran as a cooperative Gulf security partner, and internal security incidents. It reports no US strikes. [ISW/CTP](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-september-21-2026)
- 2026-09-16: ISW reports that Iran sent a "seven-day" proposal to end the conflict and links Iran's regional campaign to its trouble controlling the Strait of Hormuz. This comes from a search snippet and is unverified. [ISW/CTP](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-september-16-2026)
- 2026-09-14: US media reported that 8 US Marines were hurt by an Iranian anti-ship cruise missile in the Strait of Hormuz. This is a single-source report and CENTCOM did not respond. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/28/iran-touts-hormuz-attacks-as-oil-flows-increase-despite-tensions)
- 2026-09-08/09: CENTCOM destroyed 5 IRGC crude tankers, four in the Gulf of Oman and one near Kharg Island, after ballistic missiles were fired at a US warship. Iran says it hit about 10 ships and Jordan's Al-Azraq base. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4593050/us-destroys-5-irgc-tankers-after-iran-targets-another-american-warship/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/9/us-destroys-five-iranian-tankers-iran-retaliates-with-attacks-on-jordan-base)
- 2026-09-08: ISW assesses that Iran is targeting US naval forces more aggressively to wear down the blockade. Treasury sanctioned 36 aviation-sector targets. [ISW/CTP](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-september-08-2026)
- 2026-09-05: The US struck 3 IRGC tankers after missiles were fired at US Navy ships. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/05/nx-s1-5959159/us-iran-warships-targeted), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl)
- 2026-09-01: CENTCOM struck IRGC air defenses, radars, mine-laying sites and communications sites on Iran's southern coast, with explosions in Bandar Abbas and Qeshm. A wedding was hit, and Iran fired missiles at bases in Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait and Iraq. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4588389/centcom-completes-strikes-on-irgc-targets-in-iran/), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/09/us-airstrikes-target-irans-bandar-abbas-qeshm-island)
- 2026-08-30: The US struck rocket launchers and sea mines on Larak Island, its first strikes on Iran in about a month (the previous were on July 29). [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/30/politics/us-iran-strikes-larak-island)

## 4. Base rates
- Since the war began on February 28, US strikes on Iran have come in bursts with lulls in between:
  - a ceasefire on April 7;
  - strikes on May 7;
  - tit-for-tat strikes testing the June 28 halt;
  - 13 straight days of strikes ending in late July, with the last on July 29;
  - a roughly 30-day lull until August 30;
  - strikes on Iranian land on August 30 and September 1;
  - tanker-only strikes on September 5 and 8. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening), [Times of Israel](https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-iran-appear-to-halt-strikes-after-13-days-of-mutual-attacks/)
- PBS notes that Trump's announced halts have often been followed by new strikes within days or hours.
- So far there has been one lull of about 30 days. By September 22 the current lull on Iranian land is about 21 days, and the question needs it to last 8 more.
- US responses to Iranian missile fire in September have been aimed at tankers at sea rather than at Iranian land.

## 5. Other forecasts
- In early September, Polymarket's "US x Iran two-week ceasefire by…?" market reportedly gave 73% to a ceasefire by September 30. This is from a search snippet and unverified. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-begins-byptptpt-2-week-pause)
- A Polymarket page for this market family exists, but I could not get a reliable current price for the September 30 contract. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-ceasefire-against-iran-continues-throughptptpt)
- I found nothing on Kalshi or Manifold, and no expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before September 30
- Mediated diplomacy through Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt over Iran's "seven-day" proposal, and any US response to it.
- Further Iranian missile or drone attacks on US warships or shipping in Hormuz. These have triggered the US retaliation so far, which in September went mostly to tankers at sea.
- Enforcement of the US naval blockade, and possible Iranian mine-laying or launcher preparation. Signs of launcher preparation prompted the August 30 strikes on Iranian land.
- The November 3 US midterm elections, and oil prices near $100, may make Washington reluctant to escalate. This is an inference from earlier reporting about why the July pause happened.

Sources: links are given inline above.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

# US x Iran ceasefire through September 30: research notes (as of 2026-09-22)

Most pages I tried to open directly (Polymarket, Wikipedia, CENTCOM, CRS, NPR) were blocked by the proxy. Everything below comes from search-result summaries, so treat exact dates and figures with some caution.

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL is given. The question resolves on official statements from the US and Iranian governments and militaries, plus a consensus of credible reporting. CENTCOM's public releases are the main US primary source. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4588389/centcom-completes-strikes-on-irgc-targets-in-iran/)
- The Polymarket event page is "US-Iran ceasefire continues through...?". I could not load it, so I don't know the live status or price. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-ceasefire-against-iran-continues-throughptptpt)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing I found settles the question. The most recent qualifying US strike on Iranian land I could confirm was the CENTCOM strike wave of 2026-09-01. I found no reports of US strikes on Iranian soil between about Sept 6 and Sept 22, but I could not rule them out because coverage for Sept 10-20 was thin.
- No formal US-Iran ceasefire was in force. The June memorandum broke down on 8 July, and there has since been a de facto lull broken by flare-ups. The US naval blockade and Iran's restrictions on the Strait of Hormuz continue. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iran_war)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-15: A Congressional Research Service report counts 18 US service members killed and 824 wounded so far. It describes a war of attrition, with the two sides trading limited strikes again after the April ceasefire and the June memorandum. [CRS](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/R48887)
- 2026-09-07: CENTCOM said 94 ships had been redirected under the blockade, with 3 disabled and 2 boarded. Iran announced a new Hormuz "exclusion zone." [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-strait-of-hormuz-oil-gas-price-strikes/)
- 2026-09-05: The US struck three Iranian crude tankers after IRGC ballistic missiles were fired at a US carrier and a destroyer, which evaded them. These were ships, not land targets. Whether a ship in port counts as "internal waters" could matter for similar incidents. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/05/nx-s1-5959159/us-iran-warships-targeted), [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/09/04/u-s-iran-trade-strikes-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-both-battle-on-social-media)
- 2026-09-02: Iran retaliated with missiles and drones against US positions in Jordan, Bahrain and Iraq, and against Gulf neighbors. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/02/nx-s1-5954013/us-iran-war-latest-updates), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/2/iran-us-exchange-new-attacks-who-was-hit-in-latest-strikes)
- 2026-09-01: CENTCOM finished strikes on IRGC targets in southern Iran (Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Sirik), hitting air defenses, radars, mine-laying assets and communications sites. This followed earlier US strikes on Larak Island rocket launchers. The same day, Iran's president said Tehran would go back to the memorandum if the US did. [Stripes](https://www.stripes.com/theaters/middle_east/2026-09-01/us-forces-strike-iran-targets-22721692.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/01/us-strikes-iran-after-new-hormuz-strait-shipping-attacks-centcom.html), [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/iran/2026/09/iran-260901-sputnik04.htm), [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/09/01/iran-ceasefire-hormuz-japan/)
- 2026-07-27: The US paused its strikes after about two weeks of bombing. Trump warned they would resume if no new deal was reached. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/27/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/27/why-has-the-us-halted-its-bombing-of-iran)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 so far has seen several US strike episodes on Iranian land: the opening war phase, 7 May, a run of daily strikes in July (at least 10 days in a row), around Aug 29 (Larak) and 1 Sept. Quiet spells have lasted a few weeks. From 27 July to late August there were roughly 4-5 weeks without strikes. [Wikipedia, 7 May strikes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/7_May_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran), [JPost](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-907267)
- The pattern is that US strikes have usually come in response to IRGC attacks on shipping or on US forces. PBS noted that Trump often announces halts to strikes, but strikes keep happening. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening)
- Rough estimate from the above: in 2026, about one in three or one in four 8-day windows outside the main campaign periods included a strike on Iranian land. This is approximate.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-18: An aggregator snapshot priced the Sept 30 contract at about 52% "Yes." [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/us-ceasefire-against-iran-continues-throughptptpt)
- Undated, around late August or early September: a report said the Sept 30 "ceasefire continues" contract jumped to 79%. [PredictionNews](https://predictionnews.com/story/polymarket-prices-us-end-to-iranian-blockade-by-september-21-at-low-probability)
- 2026-09-07: The related contract "Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through Sept 30" was at 85%. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throughptptpt-20260716224448963/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-through-september-30)
- I could not find a current (Sept 20-22) price for the US contract, and found no Kalshi or Manifold equivalent. A Manifold market on a US-Iran ceasefire taking effect Aug 13-31 resolved NO. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/apol/will-iran-and-us-actually-cease-fir)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Indirect talks through Qatari and Pakistani mediators are under way. A new Iranian ceasefire or roadmap proposal could come at any point.
- The main trigger for US strikes is IRGC attacks on shipping or US warships in Hormuz, or missile and drone strikes on US bases. Watch for these and for CENTCOM statements.
- The US midterms on 2026-11-03 are a political backdrop that may make the administration less willing to escalate before the election.
- The window ends 2026-09-30 at 23:59 Iran Standard Time. If reports conflict, there is a 3-day adjudication period that can push final resolution later.
